errors.text: The proposed Si addition does not reconstruct the demonstrated 4.2 at.% Cr intervention or the resulting Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves phase.
The predicted density increase is inconsistent with the intended density mitigation and is not justified for substitution by low-atomic-mass Si.
No evidence establishes that less than 2 at.% Si will form a beneficial reticulated silicide or Laves network in this alloy rather than discrete or embrittling phases.
The Mn comparator does not cleanly isolate solid-solution hardening because Mn may differ in solubility, lattice distortion, strengthening magnitude, and phase-forming tendency.
